excluded_categories: private links and local absolute paths
credentials, cookies, tokens and private keys
log_policy: Keep reusable scenario, symptom, root cause, fix, verification and prevention; remove source identity and business-specific evidence.
promotion_gate: Deduplicate, replay, review counterexamples, run regression tests, then require maintainer approval.
behavior_fidelity_gate: P0 cases must pass 100%; P1 cases must pass at least 95%.

negative_fixture_exception.purpose: Synthetic scanner self-test only; any path or content change is blocked.
